title: All complete complexes under integral coefficient restriction
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a Noetherian scheme X, let F be the exact completed section realization [def-sfb-integral-constant-model-realization] and Res the specified constant-to-continuous scalar restriction [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. For every internal continuous-coefficient complex K, IsSfbAdicComplete(FK) is equivalent to local derived completeness of Res K for the kernel of the discrete first residue map. Moreover Res induces an equivalence of these two full subcategories of all complete complexes, together with a natural isomorphism of the inclusion composites. There is no boundedness, constructibility or Tor hypothesis.

proof.text: Use the exact section-action and small-site equivalences. Their restriction comparison is the identity on sections; localize it using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso. Chosen representatives agree with these exact derived functors through mapDerivedCategoryFactors.

The ordinary scalar map is flat, its discrete residue kernel is finite type, and it identifies the quotient by this ideal. Apply flat_ringed_ideal_complete_equivalence to obtain the equivalence of locally derived complete section modules, with its inclusion isomorphism. The exact restriction theorem preserves and reflects completeness for the extended ideal.

The completed realization tests local completeness for precisely this extended residue ideal. Completeness is invariant under the representative isomorphisms since slice restriction and internal Hom are functors. Restrict both ambient equivalences to their full complete subcategories and compose with the equivalence from the previous step. Whiskering its inclusion isomorphism with the ambient equivalences and using full faithfulness yields the required natural isomorphism with the original restriction functor.

theorem completion_transport (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    let A := fun K ↦ Scheme.IsSfbAdicComplete X (IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)
      ((IntegralConstantModel.derived l E X).functor.obj K)
    let B := fun L ↦ ConstantCompletion.IsComplete (smallMap X (residueMap l E X))
      (smallDerivedObject X _ L)
    (∀ K, A K ↔ B ((restriction l E X).obj K)) ∧
    ∃ e : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory A ≌ ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory B,
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι B ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι A ⋙ restriction l E X)
